card.name: Words just before a named title or rank
card.fires_on: Small words and modifiers such as 'the', 'higher', 'fourth', 'as' or an opening quote mark, right before a proper name, title, ranking or label is about to appear. It is mostly general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Ranking or degree adjective
modes.description: An adjective of rank or degree sits before a noun like profile or highest.
modes.example: is the<< fourth>> highest mountain in the world.

modes.label: Linking word in a list of names
modes.description: 'the' or a quote mark comes before the next named award, title or speech in a list.
modes.example: the Comstock Prize,<< the>> Award of Excellence

card.plain: It fires on little words that come just before a named item or a ranking, such as an award in a list or 'fourth' in 'fourth highest'.
evidence: give sustainable development a<< higher>> profile.
is the<< fourth>> highest mountain in the world.
the Comstock Prize,<< the>> Award of Excellence
